builds.name: Reference: Critical carry
builds.goal: Reference for Ashe: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A ranged attacker who maintains slows to kite and uses scouting and a long-range stun to start favorable fights. Can constant attack slows and scouting/R initiation generate more teamfight uptime, or does an active-support route sacrifice too much personal damage? Use a fixed Q readiness state. Attack cadence, crit and penetration support repeatable carry damage.
testPlan: Kit question for Ashe: Can constant attack slows and scouting/R initiation generate more teamfight uptime, or does an active-support route sacrifice too much personal damage? Use a fixed Q readiness state.

Start with the early core (Kraken, then Infinity Edge) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Attack cadence, crit and penetration support repeatable carry damage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Ashe builds up Focus by attacking. At maximum Focus, Ashe can cast Ranger's Focus to consume all stacks of Focus, temporarily increasing her Attack Speed and transforming her basic attack into a powerful flurry attack for the duration. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Crit is valuable only for effects that can crit; low defense makes positioning decisive.

The route fails Ashe's stated kit question: Can constant attack slows and scouting/R initiation generate more teamfight uptime, or does an active-support route sacrifice too much personal damage? Use a fixed Q readiness state.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Crit is valuable only for effects that can crit; low defense makes positioning decisive.
Full cost 16,950 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Kraken, then Infinity Edge. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Phantom Dancer, Lord Dominik's Regards, Bloodthirster are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
